reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: The first attempt of a non-streamed model call now runs under the request allowance (plus a 5 s grace) as a total deadline, so a provider that trickles its answer can no longer hold a project's work-lane request (writing transform, scope import, non-streamed chat) forever. Selected: provider adapter suites with a new trickled-answer regression, provider contracts, inference timeout and native adapter request suites, and turn preflight latency.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no interface change. The project-level effect was measured on a fake scratch Core with a trickling provider stub.
